intro: Chad is Africa's fifth-largest country, with desert in the north and savanna in the south.

chapters.title: Desert, lake and savanna
text: The Tibesti Mountains, with Emi Koussi at 3,415 m, are the highest in the Sahara. The Ennedi Plateau has rock arches and canyons. Lake Chad has shrunk by about 90% since the 1960s.

chapters.title: Zakouma
text: Zakouma National Park has saved its elephants from poachers.

places.title: Landscape tour
places.intro: Places that show the variety of Chad's landscapes. The numbers match the pins on the map.
